policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'His name shall be continued' glosses a hapax verb of propagation without fixing its stem: the qere Niphal yinnon and the ketiv Hiphil yanin both yield a name that is perpetuated, and the passive English is a rendering choice rather than a marker of one vocalization. The note 'Or, have issue' is classed alternative_rendering and so cannot decide a reading. No textual_variant note is mapped to this unit. Underdetermined; base fallback (qere) carries the projection.
